note: T-DLY-03a. Avatar Moment scripts. Placeholders only: {first_name}, {why}, {step_title}, {step_minutes}, {smaller_minutes}, {streak_days}, {time_of_day}, {weekly_count}. A variant is used only when every placeholder in it has a value. Invitations, never orders or guilt; about an 8th-grade reading level; one step plus a smaller option. review_status: pending until the clinical team approves; prod uses approved only (dev may use pending). Listed for review in REVIEW.md.

variants.text: Hi {first_name}, how did today go? What went well, and what got in the way?
Good evening, {first_name}. Take a moment: what is one thing that went well today?
How did today go? Tell me one thing that went well.
Good evening! What went well today, even if it was something small?
